rail_links.joins: The Meadowline to Heartland, Canterlot and Saddle Lake: new track outside the map from here round to Junction 5 (216, -611); the old Ponyville - Junction 5 track (seg0) across the north of the map is taken up
The Frontier Loop to Ghastly Gorge: tunnel portal; meets the existing track (seg17) where it leaves the map near (-306, -114)
Second tunnel on the map: no line goes this way yet, a siding into the hill for now
